Includes hazardous duty pay and diving duty pay in the computation of military retired pay for members of the Armed Forces with extensive hazardous duty experience. 
Directs the Comptroller General to study whether members of the National Guard and Reserve comprise a disproportionately large portion of the employees of any size or type of business, including small businesses, and whether changes can be made to the small business loan program to assist small businesses that employ members of National Guard and Reserve units. 
Directs the Secretary of Defense to report to Congress on the feasibility and desirability of expanding the Junior Reserve Officers' Training Corps program of each of the military departments, the Civil Air Patrol, the Naval Sea Cadet Corps, and the Young Marines of the Marine Corps League.

Rebuild American Manufacturing Act of 2013 - Directs the President to develop and submit to Congress a comprehensive national manufacturing strategy. Requires biennial revisions of such strategy. Sets forth goals of the strategy, including to: (1) increase the aggregate number of manufacturing jobs in the United States to at least 20% of all nonfarm jobs in the United States; (2) identify emerging technologies to strengthen the competitiveness of U.S. manufacturing in the global marketplace; and (3) strengthen the manufacturing sectors of the United States in which the United States is most competitive in the global economy.

Higher Education Fairness Act of 1997 - Amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to allow parents to contribute toward the education of their children on a tax credit.  Increases the amount of such tax credit for independent students without dependents other than a spouse.  Increases the income protection allowances for dependent students.
Grants a Federal charter to the American Military Retirees Association (a nonprofit veterans service organization incorporated under the laws of New York).

National Park Centennial Challenge Fund Act - Establishes the National Park Centennial Challenge Fund in the Treasury to be used to finance signature projects and programs to enhance the National Park System as it approaches its centennial in 2016 and to prepare the parks for another century of conservation, preservation, and enjoyment.

Directs the Secretary of the Interior, acting through the Director of the National Park Service (NPS), to develop a list of signature projects and programs eligible for funding from the Challenge Fund. Requires the list to be submitted to the President and to specified congressional committees.

Authorizes the Secretary to transfer cash donations, including cash to liquidate a letter of credit, to the Challenge Fund beginning on October 1, 2007, and ending on September 30, 2017.

Authorizes appropriations in each fiscal year from FY2007-FY2017 to equal the amount of such donations received and the pledge of donations through letters of credit, not to exceed $100 million in any one year. Prohibits the Secretary from obligating any amounts based on a letter of credit or matching a letter of credit until amounts from that letter of credit are deposited in the Challenge Fund.

Air Traffic Supervisor Retirement Reform Act of 1995 - Amends Federal law to provide for the retirement of Federal employees who serve as air traffic controllers.

Public Servant Priority Placement Act of 1995 - Amends Federal law to require the Director of the Office of Personnel Management to establish a Government-wide program and each Executive agency to establish an agency program to facilitate employment placement for Federal employees who are separated from service under a reduction in force. 
Requires each agency placement program to provide a system to require the offer of a vacant position in an agency to an employee affected by a reduction in force action, if:  (1) the position cannot be filled within the agency; (2) the employee is qualified for the offered position; (3) the offered position is equal to or no more than one grade below the employee's present or last held position; (4) the offered position's basic rate of pay is equal to the employee's present or last held position's basic rate of pay; and (5) the offered position's geographic location is within the commuting area of the employee's residence or the employee's present or last held position. 
Requires the Government-wide placement program to:  (1) coordinate with agency placement programs for the placement of agency employees affected by a reduction in force; and (2) provide a system to require the offer of a vacant position in an agency to an employee of another

Sportsmanship in Hunting Act of 2008 - Amends the federal criminal code to prohibit the interstate or foreign commerce transfer, transportation, or possession of a confined exotic animal for the purpose of allowing its killing or injuring for entertainment or for the collection of a trophy.

Exempts from such prohibition the killing or injuring of an exotic animal in a state or federal natural area reserve undertaking habitat restoration.

Helping College Students Cross the Finish Line Act - Amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to direct the Secretary of Education to award grants to institutions of higher education (IHEs) to establish programs of financial assistance for students to help underrepresented students, including first-generation students and students from low-income families, successfully complete their degree or certificate programs. Requires each grantee to provide information to each covered student (a student who receives an award under such a program) on financial assistance available from any source other than this Act's program. Directs the Secretary to create and each covered student to complete an online survey on financial literacy. Requires each grantee to report annually to the Secretary on the performance of its program, including the number of students who successfully completed its program.
